title: Algebraic Properties of the Ideal of Spectral Invariants for the Discrete Laplacian
summary: Let $Γ=q_1\mathbb{Z}\oplus q_2 \mathbb{Z}\oplus\cdots\oplus q_d\mathbb{Z}$, with $q_j\in \mathbb{Z}^+$ for each $j\in \{1,\ldots,d\}$, and denote by $Δ$ the discrete Laplacian on $\ell^2\left( \mathbb{Z}^d\right)$. We describe various algebraic properties of the ideal of spectral invariants for the discrete Laplacian when $d=1$, including a construction of a Gröbner basis. We also present various collections of complex $Γ$-periodic potentials $V$ that are such that $Δ$ and $Δ+ V$ are Floquet isospectral. We end with a discussion of the general setting, where the $q_i$ are taken to be vectors…
